recognize_zh: 綠色對比染色背景中，棕色染色在一塊區域呈纖細、分枝狀的網狀樣式，周邊則有部分細胞呈環狀膜染色，其他區域陰性；屬正常淋巴組織的免疫染色分區表現，影像解析度與抗原未標示限制了判讀。
features: Brown reticular/dendritic staining pattern concentrated in one region (right center)
Peripheral cells with ring-like membranous staining (right and lower margins)
Largely negative areas elsewhere with green counterstain
Low magnification and soft focus limit cytologic assessment
Specific antigen not identified in the image
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain with a green counterstain shows brown staining with a fine reticular, dendritic-like pattern in one region, and ring-like membranous staining of lymphoid cells at its periphery, while the remaining tissue is largely negative. The antigen is not specified and focus is soft, limiting interpretation; the pattern would fit a compartment-restricted marker within a normal follicle or its surrounding zone. Findings are consistent with normal lymphoid tissue compartmentalization.

ddx.dx: Expanded FDC meshwork (e.g., angioimmunoblastic T-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: AITL shows irregular CD21/CD23-positive FDC meshworks extending beyond follicles around HEVs, whereas the staining here is confined to a discrete region.

ddx.dx: Disrupted FDC meshwork in follicular lymphoma or NLPHL
ddx.vs: Neoplastic nodules show large expanded or fragmented meshworks throughout the node, which cannot be assessed in this single low-resolution field.
